cva6.source: ara_dsa local CVA6 fixes plus verification fence, issue-stall preservation, SSTATUS VS alias and ECALL/breakpoint/interrupt tval, non-CLIC STVEC readback/BASE consistency; integrated store-B precise exceptions, VL preview/request fallthrough/FP CSR ordering; current-lookup superpage early PPN composition
cva6.scope: Current FP16/FP32/FP64 configuration; THMULTI does not support FP8/FP8ALT; 20261009 RV64/Sv39 RVH=0 directed checks for flush allocation priority, xRET MPRV, canonical response alignment and nonleaf PTE ADU rejection

axi.source: Selective upstream splitter support, demux capacity and bank response-mask fixes; minimum two-bit demux delta for legal AR/ATOP lookup aliases
axi.scope: Actual-module directed protocol tests; bank error/exokay fix is preventive for current L2 wrapper with tied-zero status inputs

fpnew.source: ara_dsa local cast infinity, PULP HOLD and C910 round_add55 changes; FP16-INT8 cast and DIV/SQRT format/mask exception fixes
fpnew.scope: Cast and C910 active with THMULTI; 20261009 I2F overflow, cast/FMA/DIV underflow and flush fixes validated against SoftFloat, including local multifmt mantissa-bit adaptation; PULP HOLD needs separate configuration coverage
